method: Side-by-side inspection of each raw source, selected conditioned canonical avatar, selected conditioned outfit result, and the supplied outfit reference where applicable. Technical background checks are handled separately.

identity_preservation.notes: Recognizable facial geometry, hair, skin tone, smile and observable broad build are preserved.

frontal_half_body_composition.notes: Centered frontal head-to-hips studio framing with full face and hair visible.

studio_lighting.notes: Soft even studio illumination without blocking facial shadows.

neutral_white_balance.notes: Skin and neutral garment have a natural, neutral balance.

face_hair_detail.notes: Eyes, pores, teeth and hair strands retain natural high-resolution detail.

photorealism.notes: Reads as a studio photograph; no illustration or plastic-skin defect.

outfit_fidelity.notes: Canonical plain charcoal-black crew-neck T-shirt matches the requested neutral garment.

anatomy.notes: Visible head, neck, shoulders and arms are coherent; hands are outside the frame.

no_residue_or_bleed.notes: No room, earbud, chair, old graphic, halo or background bleed remains.
